summary.description: Vapcell markets the S41 as a 4100mAh 21700 cell with 45A continuous and 70A temperature-limited figures. Battery Mooch tested the exact S41 wrapper, identified the tested sample as an EVE 40PL rewrap, and estimated 40A continuous with 70A limited to 60°C. Treat this as a variable rewrap; underlying cell attribution and performance remain revision-specific. This record preserves exact-model evidence and unresolved revision caveats for the canonical catalog entry.
highlights: Exact model identity is documented; wrapper and revision continuity remain relevant.
The conservative 40A value is supported by exact-wrapper vaping testing; 70A is temperature-limited.
The tested S41 was attributed to an EVE 40PL underlying cell; future S41 batches may differ.
Runtime catalog admission is recorded separately from editorial visibility.
The catalog entry retains its measured and specification limits; default visibility remains a separate editorial decision.

claims.statement: The exact product identity is Vapcell S41 (S41), as named by the product source and exact-model test.
Vapcell markets the S41 as a 4100mAh 21700 cell with 45A maximum continuous discharge and 70A maximum discharge with a 60°C temperature cutoff.
Battery Mooch tested the exact S41 wrapper, identified it as performing like an EVE 40PL rewrap, and estimated 40A continuous with 70A temperature-limited to 60°C.
The exact Vapcell S41 has exact-model vaping test coverage.
Vapcell's current official store lists the exact S41 model for sale, supporting commercial availability of the rewrapped product.
The current 76-entry Steam Engine battery catalog contains no exact Vapcell S41 identity.

safetyFindings.summary: Mooch identified the tested S41 as an EVE 40PL rewrap, but Vapcell's current product identity does not guarantee that all S41 batches use the same underlying cell.
safetyFindings.runtimeImplication: Retain the S41 identity and conservative 40A value, but do not present the EVE 40PL attribution as universal across all S41 batches.
